scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && node scripts/go.mjs generate ./internal/startup && node scripts/go.mjs build -trimpath -o bin/ ./cmd/shipper
scripts.test: node scripts/go.mjs test ./... && npm run test --prefix web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix web && playwright test

scripts.test:docker: npm run build --prefix web && node scripts/test-docker.mjs
